remaining_doubts: color ('Black'/'Yellow') is derived from the Finish column (Black Anodize / Yellow Powder Coat); the catalog prints no separate color column.

dimension_notes labels ('T-slot opening', 'center bore', 'quarter-round outer radius', 'centerline dimension', 'spacing between the two lower holes') are interpretations of the drawings; the catalog prints only the numeric callouts (all callout values and TYP marks were checked against the images and match).

Machining services are extracted once per chunk; the four 'Tap Profile End' numbers differ by profile size (7060 = 1.50x1.50, 7014 = 1.50x0.75, 7016 = 3.00x0.75, 7045 = 1.50x3.00), and Cut to Length is 7010 for 1.50x1.50/1.50x0.75 but 7020 for 3.00x0.75/1.50x3.00. This is recorded in each service's description and in each profile's notes.
sold_per_inch is set to false (not omitted) for rows with fixed stock lengths.
